purpose: Mandatory market inputs for Roy and other PB/strategy agents before producing an investment strategy.

required_reads.role: mandatory Korean morning market brief structure, source priority, freshness and link policy
required_reads.usable_rule: schema == JJOONI_MORNING_MARKET_BRIEF_CONTRACT_V1 and required_sections contains exactly 8 ordered sections
required_reads.fallback: Do not silently drop source links, basis timestamps, closed-market disclosures or the no-estimate rule.

required_reads.role: post-close market facts and deterministic Daily Market Pulse features for the morning brief
required_reads.usable_rule: schema == JJOONI_DAILY_MARKET_PULSE_V1; raw values are facts, derived values are rule outputs, and missing web enrichments remain null/DEGRADED
required_reads.fallback: If a preferred web source is unavailable, use only the explicitly labeled canonical fallback fields and state the limitation.

required_reads.role: official US/KR macro actuals, history, revisions and macro regimes
required_reads.usable_rule: schema == JJOONI_OFFICIAL_MACRO_V1; official actual and market consensus must remain source-separated
required_reads.fallback: If an official metric is SOURCE_PENDING/DEGRADED, do not invent or infer the missing official value from market prices.
If stale/unavailable, verify current CME FedWatch on the web before using any policy probability.

required_reads.role: rates, FX, energy, volatility, indices, TRI-POD
sector rotation and ETF relative strength

fed_watch_policy.preferred_product: CME FedWatch API when licensed; otherwise CME 30-Day Fed Funds settlement-derived probability using CME methodology
fed_watch_policy.stale_behavior: Never quote a stale probability as a current fact. Refresh/verify first.
fed_watch_policy.material_change_rule: A 5 percentage-point or larger 1-day change in hike/cut probability must be explicitly surfaced in strategy rationale.

agent_instruction: Before strategy or morning-brief generation, read all required sources including morning-brief-contract.json, daily-market-pulse.json and official-macro.json. For the morning brief, verify the preferred public web sources, state each number's reference date/time and source, preserve raw/derived/commentary separation, and never estimate a value that did not update. For investment strategy, do not infer missing FedWatch or official macro values.

official_macro_policy.scope: Official macro only. Keep real yields, HY spreads, breadth, SOXX/QQQ and other market-price indicators outside this contract until the separate market-indicator phase.
official_macro_policy.actual_ssot: Fed/BLS/BEA/BOK/KOSTAT/KCS/MOTIE as applicable; transport layers must be identified separately.
official_macro_policy.history: Use 10-year history where available and preserve YoY/MoM/3M annualized/6M annualized features for inflation indices.
official_macro_policy.revisions: Never overwrite revisions silently. Read vintage_history for release revisions.
official_macro_policy.consensus: Consensus is market data, never an official-source actual.
official_macro_policy.regime: Regime labels are informational features and must not be used as a standalone AUTOBOT trade trigger.

morning_market_brief_policy.web_verification: Required for every daily brief even when SSOT canonical fallback values exist.
morning_market_brief_policy.basis_time: State market/reference date and observation time next to numerical claims.
morning_market_brief_policy.closed_market: Use latest completed trading session and disclose it; never estimate missing values.
morning_market_brief_policy.link_policy: Show clickable primary source link next to the relevant section and repeat all links in the final 바로가기 section.
morning_market_brief_policy.fact_boundary: raw observations != deterministic derived labels != AI commentary
